patients.name: Luma
patients.intro: Luma keeps dreaming of a ladder made of moonlight. Every step breaks before the top.
clues: The nightmare smells like warm milk and old paper.
Luma says the moon never answers letters.
A tiny envelope is tucked under one paw.
patients.dreamGift: A moonlit mailbox that rings once, even when the answer is still far away.
patients.morningAnchor: Tomorrow, Luma will write the first real letter instead of waiting for the perfect one.

patients.name: Mori
patients.intro: Mori's dream forest loops forever. A friend keeps waving from the path he did not take.
clues: The same leaf falls every twelve seconds.
A seed glows whenever the dream turns backward.
patients.dreamGift: A clearing where the missed goodbye can be spoken without the forest ending.
patients.morningAnchor: Mori wakes with one seed to plant beside the old road.

patients.name: Nini
patients.intro: Nini is transparent tonight. A dark little storm keeps tapping from inside her chest.
clues: The storm grows louder when the room is silent.
Nini laughs whenever she is about to cry.
Her shadow is trying to hide under the clipboard.
patients.dreamGift: A corked rain bottle, small enough to hold and safe enough to open later.
patients.morningAnchor: Nini learns she can name a feeling before it fills the whole room.

patients.name: Puff
patients.intro: Puff wants wings, but every dream flight ends with the city lights drifting away.
clues: The wind chime only rings when Puff looks down.
Puff whispers that roofs are almost skies.
patients.dreamGift: One safe flight over the rooftops, with every window glowing hello.
patients.morningAnchor: Puff decides to climb to the roof tomorrow and watch the sunrise from there.

patients.name: Fenn
patients.intro: Fenn's lantern goes out whenever the dream asks him to step onto a stage.
clues: Tiny applause hides inside the lantern glass.
Fenn knows the song but not the first note.
The nightmare is brightest just before he begins.
patients.dreamGift: A stage where the first note can tremble and still count.
patients.morningAnchor: Fenn wakes ready to sing badly once, which is how songs begin.

patients.name: No. 7
patients.intro: No. 7 arrives with no name tag. The dream door behind them locks itself twice.
clues: The nightmare repeats your last sentence in a smaller voice.
A blank collar waits beside the dream door.
patients.dreamGift: A quiet room where the word monster turns back into the word scared.
patients.morningAnchor: No. 7 leaves with a blank tag and permission to choose a name later.
